Name: Gauth Unlimited Digital Canvas
Tagline: An AI tutor on an infinite whiteboard, not a chat thread
Description: Gauth AI Course now runs on an Unlimited Digital Canvas: one continuous whiteboard where lessons unfold spatially instead of in a chat thread or slide deck. Chapters expand side by side as narration plays, board notes write out in sync with the AI voice, and you can zoom from the full concept map down to a single formula. Pause anytime to ask the AI Tutor, and it answers right on the board beneath your step. Generate a canvas lesson on any topic, then export it as a PDF or share a link.

Name: Famulor
Tagline: Your agent to answer calls and follow ups on WhatsApp
Description: Famulor answers calls, runs campaigns and follows up on WhatsApp. GDPR-ready, EU hosting. Try it free.

Name: ShipHQ
Tagline: Build your own app studio, powered by your real apps
Description: ShipHQ turns your app's real numbers into a living isometric startup office. Connect RevenueCat and every paying subscriber becomes a person at your desks. Each morning the Daily Brief replays last night: new subscribers walk in to applause, trials arrive in caps, churn gets a send-off. Milestones land as trophies on your wall — earned, never bought, never retroactive. AI managers bring a 09:00 standup on growth, reviews and competitors. Free on iPhone.

Name: Bambu Lab R1
Tagline: CO2 laser cutting with Bambu-style automation
Description: Bambu Lab R1 is a 55W CO2 laser cutter built around automation. It handles optical alignment, material positioning and surface tracking for you, with a 600 × 300 mm work area, clear acrylic support, and optional conveyor processing up to 3 meters.

Name: Veltrix AI for E-commerce
Tagline: Find how your e-commerce business could earn more
Description: Find ways to make your e-commerce business more profitable. Veltrix uses AI to analyze your sales, costs, customers and marketing. Get help deciding what to promote, where to cut spending and how to solve problems holding the business back. Connect your business tools or upload files. Start with a Business Health Check to find improvements you may have missed. Then use Veltrix to work out what to improve. Your first check is free. No card required.

Name: Mintlify Desktop
Tagline: An AI-native app for writing documentation and knowledge
Description: A dedicated home for all your documentation, from internal knowledge bases, runbooks and onboarding guides to public docs. Keep projects open side by side across organizations and pick up where you left off. An agent works alongside you on the page you’re editing, while local files let you write offline and sync when you reconnect. Tabs, split views, and persistent sessions help you move between projects without losing context.

Name: Clef
Tagline: Open-source decision models from Cloudflare
Description: Clef is a 27B multimodal model that turns a state and a schema of typed questions into decisions. It reads the state as text, JSON, images, or video, and returns a probability for every allowed option of every question in a single forward pass. There is no free-form text generation and no output parsing. The Clef API is fully compatible with Jev and SystemOne.

Name: Open Inspector
Tagline: Hover any website, get its design system. No permissions.
Topics: Chrome Extensions, Open Source, Developer Tools, GitHub
Description: A free, open-source browser extension for inspecting layout, styles, colour, type and assets on any page, and exporting its design tokens. Unlike the popular alternatives, it requests no site access and makes zero network requests. MIT, no account.

Name: Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo
Tagline: Elevenlabs' fastest and most emotive voice models yet
Description: Meet Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo by ElevenLabs, their most expressive models yet, with Turbo built for real-time use. Available in apps, API, and agents.

Name: Syllaby AI Avatar 2.0
Tagline: Create Your Own Avatar In Seconds
Description: Turn a script or simple idea into a complete presenter-led video with a realistic AI avatar, natural voice, B-roll and subtitles—without hiring actors,

Name: Anthroposcaper
Tagline: Tag a 2D plan, get a 3D urban environment model
Description: Draw a 2D plan in the browser or import a DXF, then tag its faces and lines. Turn your own GLB models into templates, and Anthroposcaper lays them along every matching edge, corners and junctions included, into a textured 3D scene. Change one tag or drawing and the scene rebuilds. Export to GLB for your 3D editor or game engine. Connect your AI agent over MCP: it helps set up templates, configure tags and materials, and keep the project organized. You stay in control of the result.

Name: CodeAF
Tagline: Open Source Software Factory
Topics: Open Source, Software Engineering, Developer Tools, GitHub
Description: CodeAF is a coding harness built for open models, to get the most out of every dollar. Frontier-grade coding on open models, at a fraction of the cost.I t is also a different way to work once more than one thing is going on: instead of three terminals of agents with you in the middle, one window where you hand work off, see what is moving across every project, and step in only where your judgment is needed.

Name: Codync
Tagline: The open-source alternative to Grok Bot, Muse and Dots
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Everything Grok Bot, Muse and Dots do, open source and 100% free. Run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or 40+ agents as named bots on your own computer, then reply and approve from your iPhone, Mac, Linux or terminal. MIT, end-to-end encrypted.

Name: Communicate
Tagline: AI support agents grounded in your knowledge, with handoff
Description: Build AI support agents from your help docs, files, and past replies. Answer questions and run tasks you approve, with human handoff in a shared inbox. Add website chat, track conversations, and connect through the API or read-only MCP. Plans start at $19/month. Product Hunt offer: PRODUCTHUNT50 gives 50% off your first monthly plan payment through October 9. A separate lifetime launch offer is available on our website.

Name: Earlyn
Tagline: Searchable memory of your screen and meetings, on your Mac
Description: Earlyn keeps an encrypted, searchable memory of what's on your Mac's screen and in your meetings, and answers questions about your day. Scrub back through a timeline, find any word you saw, get meeting transcripts in any language with live translation, and give Claude Code, Codex or Cursor your context over MCP. Capture, search and transcription run on your Mac; nothing is sent unless you pick a cloud model or connect an app. 7 days free, then $19/month.

Name: Cue by Manus
Tagline: Personal agents with identity, handling life end to end
Description: Whatever life brings, your personal agents on Cue handle it — each with its own email, phone number, wallet and computer to get real work done.

Name: Never Boring AI
Tagline: The AI agent that writes your LinkedIn posts in your voice
Description: Never Boring AI is an AI agent for LinkedIn. It interviews you about your work, keeps your stories in memory and turns them into posts written in your voice. It plans your content weeks ahead, learns from every edit you make, then schedules and publishes on LinkedIn for you. Built for freelancers, consultants and founders who know what they do but never know what to post this week. Works in English and French.

Name: Teachoo
Tagline: AI that helps you learn anything and everything.
Description: Teachoo helps students work through homework one question at a time. Type a problem or upload a photo, then work toward the answer with guided questions, feedback and hints. Need more help? Ask for a bigger hint or an explanation of the step. Free to use. Try a problem you haven’t solved in years.

Name: Pastily
Tagline: Your clipboard but better
Topics: Productivity, Developer Tools, Menu Bar Apps
Description: Fast, private clipboard manager for macOS, Windows and Linux. Searchable copy history, paste queue, images and snippets. 100% offline, pay once.

Name: Lloyal
Tagline: Turn open-weight models into AI apps people can download
Description: Start with a working TypeScript AI app with built-in inference and a multi-agent runtime. In-app agents can research, read local files, understand documents and compose specialist models. Works offline, no API keys or complicated setup for your users. Customize and ship it to desktop, web or terminal in minutes 🚀
